question: Calculate the total income from Meat Lovers pizzas priced at $12 and Vegetarian pizzas at $10. Include any extra toppings charged at $1 each. Ensure that canceled orders are filtered out. How much money has Pizza Runner earned in total?
sql:
WITH order_pizzas AS (
    SELECT 
        cco.order_id,
        cco.pizza_id,
        cco.extras,
        CASE 
            WHEN cco.pizza_id = 1 THEN 12
            WHEN cco.pizza_id = 2 THEN 10
            ELSE 0
        END AS base_price,
        CASE 
            WHEN cco.extras = '' OR cco.extras IS NULL THEN 0
            ELSE (LENGTH(cco.extras) - LENGTH(REPLACE(cco.extras, ',', ''))) + 1
        END AS extra_count
    FROM pizza_clean_customer_orders cco
    INNER JOIN pizza_clean_runner_orders cro ON cco.order_id = cro.order_id
    WHERE cro.cancellation IS NULL OR cro.cancellation = ''
)
SELECT 
    SUM(base_price + extra_count * 1) AS total_income
FROM order_pizzas;
